# moq_usage (Data Source)

Reads a project's metered usage, aggregated by UTC calendar period. The [API reference](https://moq.pro/doc/api) defines each quantity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "moq_usage" "monthly" {
  project_id = moq_project.example.id
  period     = "month"
  from       = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

output "egress_bytes" {
  value = sum([for m in data.moq_usage.monthly.items : m.egress_external_bytes])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project's immutable ID.

### Optional

- `from` (String) Inclusive RFC 3339 bound on period starts. Defaults to 30 days before `to`.
- `period` (String) Aggregation grain: `minute`, `hour`, `day` (the default), `month`, `year`, or `forever`.
- `to` (String) Exclusive RFC 3339 bound on period starts. Defaults to now.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) One entry per period, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `agent_seconds` (Number) Live voice agent-seconds, billable.
- `cost_micros` (Number) Gross cost in micro-USD, before allowances and credit.
- `egress_external_bytes` (Number) Live payload bytes delivered, billable.
- `ingress_bytes` (Number) Publisher payload bytes received, never billed.
- `partial` (Boolean) Whether the period is still incomplete.
- `period_end` (String) Period end, RFC 3339.
- `period_start` (String) Period start, RFC 3339.
- `stored_gb_seconds` (Number) Managed storage in GB·second, billable.
- `transcode_1080_seconds` (Number) Encoded 1080p rendition-seconds, billable.
- `transcode_480_seconds` (Number) Encoded 480p rendition-seconds, billable.
- `transcode_720_seconds` (Number) Encoded 720p rendition-seconds, billable.
- `vod_egress_bytes` (Number) Recording delivery bytes, billable.
- `vod_recording_bytes` (Number) Managed recording bytes written, billable.
